unit_of_assignment: none; eligibility changes deterministically at the diagnostic-score cutoff
exposure_mechanism: applicants with diagnostic_score below 60 are eligible for the tutoring offer; applicants at or above 60 are not eligible
target_estimand: local average effect of tutoring eligibility on end-term mathematics score for applicants at the diagnostic-score cutoff of 60
warning: This simulation is not a validated model of tutoring or student performance. The cutoff rule is deterministic, not randomized, and an RD interpretation requires continuity and no precise manipulation near the cutoff.
causal_structure: diagnostic score determines tutoring eligibility at a cutoff of 60
smooth functions of diagnostic score affect baseline GPA and the untreated outcome
tutoring eligibility adds a discontinuity of 4.2 outcome points
independent baseline and outcome noise create sampling variation

structural_equations.end_term_math_score: smooth quadratic score function + 1.7*(baseline_gpa-2.75) + 4.2*tutoring_eligible + independent noise

missing_value_code: none; all six fields are complete

variables.name: centered_score
variables.role: diagnostic score centered at the cutoff

variables.name: tutoring_eligible
variables.time: determined after diagnostic testing and before tutoring
variables.unit: 1 eligible below 60; 0 not eligible at or above 60

variables.name: baseline_gpa
variables.role: pre-intervention covariate used for a continuity diagnostic

variables.name: end_term_math_score
variables.time: end of term after tutoring eligibility

site_or_time_variables: single fictional tutoring program and one end-of-term outcome
